subject.title: ci: isolate legacy QA smoke invocations

question: Should this fix merge with the exact frozen-beta rerun performed immediately afterward, or should merge wait for a new pre-merge legacy-planner harness?
rationale: The failure and fix boundary are well supported, but GitHub only executes the frozen target with the trusted default-branch workflow, so normal PR checks cannot provide the final end-to-end proof.

options.title: Land, then verify frozen beta
options.body: Merge the focused fix and immediately rerun the exact frozen beta target, treating any remaining timeout or coverage loss as a release-validation blocker.

options.title: Require a legacy fixture first
options.body: Pause merge until a safe pre-merge harness can load the frozen legacy planner, gaining earlier proof at the cost of delaying the active workflow repair.

recommendation.title: Land, then verify frozen beta
recommendation.body: Merge the focused fix and immediately rerun the exact frozen beta target, treating any remaining timeout or coverage loss as a release-validation blocker.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work introduced and owns the frozen-target compatibility path being refined.
